description: This file implements quorum management for the etcd Raft consensus algorithm, specifically handling majority configurations, including representation, sorting, index calculation, and voting logic.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the majority configuration IDs.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Provides a multi-line visual representation of commit indexes for the configuration.

methods.name: Slice
methods.description: Returns the configuration IDs as a sorted slice.

methods.name: CommittedIndex
methods.description: Calculates the committed index based on acknowledged indexes from voters.

methods.name: VoteResult
methods.description: Determines the outcome of a vote (won, pending, lost) based on votes from configuration members.
